description: Gate rules for the acceptance ledger (docs/REHEARSAL-ACCEPTANCE-LEDGER.md G0-G9). A gate is PASS only when it names producers and every one succeeded in the candidate run; FAIL when any failed; NOT_RUN otherwise. Producers are CI jobs/checks reported in producers.json by .github/workflows/build-and-test.yml; 'traceability' is computed from the bound obligations. Add a producer here only when CI really produces it.

gates.title: Scope
gates.definition: requirement ids, owner, profile priority, source precedence resolution
gates.note: preservation-gate: the CI job preservation-gate re-runs `praxis requirements preservation verify` exactly as recorded in evidence/requirements-preservation/gate-pre-implementation-command.txt (Indy-init 459f65a + aab8f80, Praxis 3.22.0 from the pinned channel); success only on exit 0 and verdict pass

gates.title: Dependencies
gates.definition: verified package/SHA/integrity lock, SDK, WASM/Forma/Folio smoke
gates.note: lock-gate is the T11 stack lock gate (PASS needs package-lock.json); stack-smoke is computed (producers.stack-smoke): Limen startup / Forma render / Folio print / WASM engine browser tests tagged @stack-smoke-* plus the frozen golden replay

gates.title: Interfaces
gates.definition: frozen versioned handoff manifest and producer/consumer tests
gates.note: interface-manifest is computed (producers.interface-manifest): the committed docs/architecture/interface-manifest.json and its staleness test

gates.title: Domain
gates.definition: F# unit tests, illegal-transition and forged-history variants
gates.note: domain-obligations is computed (producers.domain-obligations): plan requirements routed to G3 (the plan routes none), the engine suite, illegal-transition and forged-history tests

gates.title: Frozen data
gates.definition: five golden scenarios, hashes, negative fixtures
gates.note: frozen-data is computed (producers.frozen-data): plan requirements routed to G4 and the T15 fixture replay against causa-data (pinned)

gates.title: UI
gates.definition: P0 screen contracts, startup/error, iPad/keyboard/a11y, projection fidelity
gates.note: percepta-verify-app: the CI job percepta runs `percepta verify-app` against the built site when .percepta/bindings.json and dist/ exist; NOT_RUN otherwise

gates.title: Persistence
gates.definition: local vs remote truth, expected-version conflict, reload, no fixture mutation
gates.note: the live provider suite (CAUSA_GITHUB_TOKEN / CAUSA_TEST_REPO), main pushes only

gates.title: Defect class
gates.definition: independent review and SHA-bound closure for critical/recurring classes
gates.note: defect-class-review is computed (producers.defect-class-review): every class closed by the independent reviewer (T33) in acceptance/defect-classes.json with a fix SHA in the candidate's history, and its failing-first tests passed in this run

gates.title: Candidate
gates.note: traceability succeeds only when every plan obligation is bound to executed tests that all passed

gates.title: Deployment
gates.definition: deployed SHA equals verified SHA, successful acceptance job on same SHA
gates.note: deploy and deployed-smoke run on main pushes when DEPLOY_TARGET=github-pages

producers.description: DEP-CURRENT-004 stack smoke: Limen startup, Forma render, Folio print and the WASM engine in a real browser (tests tagged @stack-smoke-limen/-forma/-folio/-wasm) and the frozen golden replay.
T14: the frozen versioned handoff manifest is committed and equals the extraction from the compiled kernel (staleness test).
G3: every plan requirement routed to G3 bound and passing; the F# engine suite ran and passed, including illegal-transition and forged-history variants.
G4 / T15: the frozen fixture replay against causa-data (storage contract v1.0.0): five golden scenarios, byte-identical rewrite, 90 negative fixtures, locked digests, historical catalog.

G7: every defect class in acceptance/defect-classes.json closed by the independent reviewer (status PASS, fix SHA in the candidate's history, reviewer evidence), and its failing-first tests passed in this run. Only the reviewer edits closures.
